meta.title: Country Conditions
meta.source: World Bank, World Development Indicators and Worldwide Governance Indicators

rule_of_law.name: Rule of Law - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)

corruption.name: Control of Corruption - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)

stability.name: Political Stability - Governance estimate (approx. -2.5 to +2.5)
stability.note: Political stability and absence of violence; about -2.5 to 2.5.

fdi.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
fdi.note: Net inflows of foreign direct investment.

trade_open.name: Trade (% of GDP)
trade_open.note: Exports plus imports of goods and services.

current_acct.name: Current account balance (% of GDP)
current_acct.note: Positive values are surpluses, negative values deficits.

pat_res.name: Patent applications, residents
pat_res.note: Patent applications filed by residents of the country, all patent offices reporting to WIPO.
pat_res.organization: WIPO Patent Report: Statistics on Worldwide Patent Activity, World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), note: The International Bureau of WIPO assumes no responsibility with respect to the transformation of these data.

pat_nres.name: Patent applications, nonresidents
pat_nres.note: Patent applications filed in the country by nonresidents; a signal of foreign interest in protecting inventions there.
pat_nres.organization: WIPO Patent Report: Statistics on Worldwide Patent Activity, World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), note: The International Bureau of WIPO assumes no responsibility with respect to the transformation of these data.

trademarks.name: Trademark applications, nonresident, by count
trademarks.note: Trademark applications filed in the country by nonresidents, by count; a signal of foreign brands entering the market.
trademarks.organization: Statistics Database, World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO), uri: www.wipo.int/ipstats/, note: The International Bureau of WIPO assumes no responsibility with respect to the transformation of these data.

rnd.name: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)
rnd.note: Gross domestic spending on research and development.
rnd.organization: Stat Bulk Data Download Service, UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), uri: https://databrowser.uis.unesco.org/resources/bulk, publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), date accessed: 2025-03-26, date published: 2025-02

hightech.name: High-technology exports (% of manufactured exports)
hightech.note: Exports with high R&D intensity, such as aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals and scientific instruments.
hightech.organization:
Comtrade database, United Nations (UN), uri: comtrade.un.org, publisher: UN Statistics Division;
World Integrated Trade Solution system (WITS), World Bank (WB), uri: https://wits.worldbank.org/

ip_paid.name: Charges for the use of intellectual property, payments (BoP, current US$)
ip_paid.note: Payments to other countries for the use of patents, trademarks, copyrights and similar rights, current US dollars.
ip_paid.organization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

ip_recv.name: Charges for the use of intellectual property, receipts (BoP, current US$)
ip_recv.note: Receipts from other countries for the use of the country's intellectual property, current US dollars.
ip_recv.organization: Balance of Payments Statistics Yearbook and data files, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

gdp.name: GDP (current US$)
gdp.note: Gross domestic product in current US dollars; a rough guide to market size.

unemployment.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
unemployment.organization: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

gini.name: Gini index
gini.note: 0 is perfect equality, 100 perfect inequality. Measured in survey years only.
gini.organization: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform. Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database. For more information and methodology, please see http://pip.worldbank.org., World Bank (WB), uri: http://pip.worldbank.org, note: Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database.

remittances.name: Personal remittances, received (% of GDP)
remittances.note: Personal transfers and compensation of employees received.

life_exp.name: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)

under5.name: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
under5.note: Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births.

health_spend.name: Current health expenditure (% of GDP)
health_spend.organization: Global Health Expenditure Database, updated December 12th, 2025, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://apps.who.int/nha/database

co2.name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
co2.note: Carbon dioxide emissions per person, excluding land use change.
co2.organization:
EDGAR (Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research) Community GHG Database, Joint Research Centre (JRC) - European Commission, uri: https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ghg2024, publisher: JRC European Commission, date published: 2024;
International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ghg2024, publisher: JRC European Commission, date published: 2024

renewables.name: Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)
renewables.note: Renewable share of total final energy consumption. Includes traditional biomass.
renewables.organization: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

pm25.name: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter)
pm25.note: Mean annual exposure to fine particulate matter.
pm25.organization: Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) Air Pollution Exposure Estimates and Risk Curves 1990-2023, GBD Collaborator Network, uri: https://ghdx.healthdata.org/record/ihme-data/gbd-2023-air-pollution-exposure-estimates-1990-2023, note: Need to create account to retrieve data., publisher: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME), date accessed: 2026-04-03, date published: 2026-01-23

ETH.note: Joined the Paris Convention (in force 15 August 2025). Not a PCT member, so patents must be filed directly with the national office.

POL.note: The EU is on the 2026 Watch List over EU-wide issues (geographical indications, pharmaceutical data protection, platform rules); not counted as a listing of member states.

ROU.note: The EU is on the 2026 Watch List over EU-wide issues (geographical indications, pharmaceutical data protection, platform rules); not counted as a listing of member states.

HUN.note: The EU is on the 2026 Watch List over EU-wide issues (geographical indications, pharmaceutical data protection, platform rules); not counted as a listing of member states.

ARG.note: Not a PCT member, so patents must be filed directly with the national office.

USA.note: The Special 301 Report assesses US trading partners, so it does not rate the United States.

DEU.note: The EU is on the 2026 Watch List over EU-wide issues (geographical indications, pharmaceutical data protection, platform rules); not counted as a listing of member states.
